```{r}
#| include: false

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Course calendar.
#
# NO DATES LIVE IN THIS FILE. Everything comes from course-dates.json, where
# deadlines are stored as (week, day) offsets from the first week of class. To
# roll the course to a new year, edit the `term` block of that file -- the month
# grids, the legend and the key-dates table all follow.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

source(here::here("course-dates.R"))
cal <- read_course_dates()

term_start <- cal$first_class_day
term_end   <- cal$last_class_day
no_class   <- cal$no_class$date

new_event <- function(date, time, label, type) {
  data.frame(
    date = as.Date(date), time = time, label = label, type = type,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Finals week runs Monday to Friday from the registrar's start date.
finals_days <- cal$finals_week_starts + 0:4

events <- rbind(
  # --- recurring meetings -------------------------------------------------
  # A midterm *is* that day's lecture, so read_course_dates() has already
  # removed exam days from `lecture_days` rather than stacking two chips.
  new_event(cal$lecture_days, cal$lecture_time, "Lecture", "lecture"),
  new_event(cal$lab_days,     cal$lab_time,     "R Lab",   "lab"),

  # --- everything scheduled: exams, releases, deadlines -------------------
  new_event(cal$events$date, cal$events$time, cal$events$title, cal$events$type),

  # --- university calendar ------------------------------------------------
  new_event(term_start, "", "First day of classes", "term"),
  new_event(no_class,   "", cal$no_class$label,     "holiday"),
  new_event(max(cal$lab_days), "", "Last R Lab",    "term"),
  new_event(finals_days, "", "Finals week",         "finals")
)

# Chips within a day are ordered by type, not by insertion, so a deadline never
# hides below the routine lecture chip.
type_rank <- c(exam = 1, deadline = 2, release = 3, lecture = 4, lab = 5,
               term = 6, holiday = 7, finals = 8)
events <- events[order(events$date, type_rank[events$type]), ]

chip_html <- function(rows) {
  if (nrow(rows) == 0) return("")
  paste0(
    '<div class="cal-chip cal-', rows$type, '">',
    ifelse(nzchar(rows$time), paste0('<span class="cal-time">', rows$time, '</span> '), ''),
    rows$label,
    '</div>',
    collapse = ""
  )
}

month_html <- function(year, month) {
  first <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", year, month))
  last  <- seq(first, by = "month", length.out = 2)[2] - 1
  start <- first - as.integer(format(first, "%w"))          # back to Sunday
  end   <- last + (6 - as.integer(format(last, "%w")))      # out to Saturday
  grid  <- seq(start, end, by = "day")

  cells <- vapply(grid, function(d) {
    d <- as.Date(d, origin = "1970-01-01")
    in_month <- format(d, "%Y-%m") == format(first, "%Y-%m")
    day_events <- events[events$date == d, ]
    paste0(
      '<div class="cal-day', if (!in_month) " is-out" else "", '">',
      '<div class="cal-num">',
      if (format(d, "%d") == "01") format(d, "%b %e") else format(d, "%e"),
      '</div>',
      if (in_month) chip_html(day_events) else "",
      '</div>'
    )
  }, character(1))

  paste0(
    '<section class="cal-month">',
    '<h2 class="cal-title">', format(first, "%B %Y"), '</h2>',
    '<div class="cal-grid">',
    paste0('<div class="cal-dow">',
           c("Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"),
           '</div>', collapse = ""),
    paste0(cells, collapse = ""),
    '</div></section>'
  )
}
```

```{=html}
<style>
/* Palette borrowed from the lecture decks' Notebook theme (lectures/notebook.scss)
   so the calendar reads as part of the same course, not a bolted-on page. */
:root {
  --cal-paper:     #fbf9f3;
  --cal-ink:       #22201b;
  --cal-muted:     #5d574a;
  --cal-rule:      #e2dcd0;
  --cal-accent:    #1d4e89;
  --cal-sienna:    #a8552b;
  --cal-tint:      #eef2f8;
  --cal-tint-warm: #f6efe6;
}

.cal-legend {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
  margin: 0 0 1.75rem; padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  background: var(--cal-paper); border: 1px solid var(--cal-rule);
  border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.cal-legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; }
.cal-swatch {
  /* <i> is inline by default, which ignores width/height and collapses the
     swatch to a sliver -- inline-block is what makes it a square. */
  display: inline-block; width: 0.95rem; height: 0.95rem;
  border-radius: 3px; border-left: 3px solid transparent;
}

.cal-month { margin: 0 0 2.75rem; }
.cal-title {
  font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  color: var(--cal-ink); margin: 0 0 0.6rem; padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--cal-rule);
}

.cal-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1px; background: var(--cal-rule);
  border: 1px solid var(--cal-rule); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden;
}

.cal-dow {
  background: var(--cal-paper); color: var(--cal-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-align: center; padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem;
}

.cal-day {
  background: #fff; min-height: 7.5rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.4rem 0.55rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
}
.cal-day.is-out { background: #faf9f7; }
.cal-day.is-out .cal-num { color: #c3bdb2; }

.cal-num {
  font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--cal-muted);
  margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

.cal-chip {
  font-size: 0.74rem; line-height: 1.25; border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 0.22rem 0.4rem; margin-bottom: 0.22rem;
  border-left: 3px solid transparent; overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.cal-time { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; opacity: 0.75; }

.cal-lecture  { background: var(--cal-tint-warm); border-left-color: var(--cal-sienna); color: #4a3a2c; }
.cal-lab      { background: var(--cal-tint);      border-left-color: var(--cal-accent); color: #1d3557; }
.cal-exam     { background: #f6dfd4; border-left-color: #b3341b; color: #7d2413; font-weight: 600; }
.cal-deadline { background: var(--cal-sienna); border-left-color: #7d3d1f; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; }
/* An assignment going out is the quiet counterpart of one coming due, so it
   gets a tinted chip rather than the solid fill deadlines use. */
.cal-release  { background: #e6f2f2; border-left-color: #2a7a7a; color: #1d5252; }
.cal-deadline .cal-time { opacity: 0.85; }
.cal-term     { background: #e4efe4; border-left-color: #3f7a46; color: #27502c; }
.cal-holiday  { background: #ececec; border-left-color: #9a9a9a; color: #4f4f4f; }
.cal-finals   { background: #f0edf7; border-left-color: #6d28d9; color: #3f2072; }

/* Below tablet width a 7-column grid stops being readable, so the month
   collapses into a single column and empty leading/trailing days drop out. */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .cal-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .cal-dow { display: none; }
  .cal-day { min-height: 0; flex-direction: row; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.6rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .cal-day.is-out { display: none; }
  .cal-num { margin-bottom: 0; min-width: 2.5rem; }
}
</style>
```

`r cal$label`. Lectures meet **MW 3:00–4:30 PM**; R labs meet **F 1:00–2:30 PM**.
Semester dates follow the [UNL academic calendar](`r cal$registrar_calendar`).

```{=html}
<div class="cal-legend">
  <span><i class="cal-swatch cal-lecture"></i> Lecture (MW)</span>
  <span><i class="cal-swatch cal-lab"></i> R Lab (F)</span>
  <span><i class="cal-swatch cal-exam"></i> Midterm</span>
  <span><i class="cal-swatch cal-release"></i> Assignment released</span>
  <span><i class="cal-swatch cal-deadline"></i> Due date</span>
  <span><i class="cal-swatch cal-term"></i> Term milestone</span>
  <span><i class="cal-swatch cal-holiday"></i> No class</span>
  <span><i class="cal-swatch cal-finals"></i> Finals week</span>
</div>
```

## Key dates

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

key <- events[events$type %in% c("exam", "deadline", "release", "term"), ]
key <- key[order(key$date, type_rank[key$type]), ]

# The note column in course-dates.json carries the detail worth showing here
# ("in class, open book"); fall back to the bare title when there is none.
notes <- setNames(cal$events$note, cal$events$title)
detail <- ifelse(!is.na(notes[key$label]), notes[key$label], "")

cat(": {tbl-colwidths=\"[22,78]\"}\n\n")
cat("| Date | Item |\n|:-----------------|:----------------------------------|\n")
cat(paste0(
  "| **", format(key$date, "%a, %b %e"), "** | ", key$label,
  ifelse(nzchar(detail), paste0(" — ", detail), ""), " |"
), sep = "\n")
cat("\n")
```

## Month by month

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

months <- seq(as.Date(format(term_start, "%Y-%m-01")),
              as.Date(format(max(events$date), "%Y-%m-01")), by = "month")
for (m in months) {
  m <- as.Date(m, origin = "1970-01-01")
  cat(month_html(as.integer(format(m, "%Y")), as.integer(format(m, "%m"))))
}
```
